description: Source code for an ACP client implementation in TypeScript, including functions for permission handling, process spawning, session management, and interactive CLI.

classes.name: AcpClientHandle
classes.description: Handle object containing the client connection, agent process, and session ID.

methods.name: resolvePermissionRequest
methods.description: Resolves a permission request, possibly prompting the user or auto-approving based on classification.

methods.name: createAcpClient
methods.description: Initializes and spawns an ACP client process, establishing a connection and session.

methods.name: runAcpClientInteractive
methods.description: Runs an interactive CLI for the ACP client, allowing user prompts and command input.
